description: This file defines the AdminWatchlistQueryService class, which provides methods for querying watchlist entries, their details, booking reports, and pending report counts within an administrative context. It interacts with repositories for watchlist, booking reports, and users, and handles data enrichment such as associating user information with audit logs.

classes.name: AdminWatchlistQueryService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to query watchlist entries, details, booking reports, and pending report counts with data enrichment and access control.

methods.name: listWatchlistEntries
methods.description: Retrieves watchlist entries with associated user data for the latest audit, supporting search and filtering.

methods.name: getWatchlistEntryDetails
methods.description: Fetches detailed information and audit history for a specific watchlist entry, ensuring it is a system/global entry.

methods.name: listBookingReports
methods.description: Retrieves grouped reported bookings based on input filters and sorting.

methods.name: getPendingReportsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of system pending booking reports.
